From Schott Key No.1 · Price: touch only, and only from your left hand to your right.

Theme Space

  • 1: 1 action: anything your left hand touches (Bulk 1 or less, unattended) moves to your right hand. Your stand's hands can serve as your left and right hands. 1 action: your stand's left hand touches a creature and moves a scrap of it into its right hand: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}).
  • 5: Attended objects (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates), letting you Disarm with a touch. Surge: tear a larger piece out of a creature your stand touches: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}), and on a failure it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 1} for 1 round.
  • 9: Surge: move a creature's held weapon into your hand (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates), or remove a 5-ft section of wall you touch, leaving a hole.
  • 13: Move a Small creature your left hand touches to any space within 10 ft of you (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 17: Move a Medium creature.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
